prompt: /create-plan Add a new "bugfix" skill that helps users debug failing tests by analyzing test output and suggesting fixes

assertions.text: Response shows evidence of inspecting existing skills in core/skills/ to identify patterns to follow
Plan includes key template sections: Overview, Current State Analysis, Desired End State, Implementation Phases, and Success Criteria
Plan contains specific file path references to real files in the repository (e.g., core/skills/bugmagnet/SKILL.md)
Plan defines at least 2 distinct implementation phases
Each implementation phase includes verifiable success criteria (automated commands or checkable conditions)
Plan is saved to (or mentions saving to) thoughts/shared/plans/ with the correct YYYY-MM-DD-description.md naming format
